hypothesis: Both earlier stage-free empirical agents made the same 576 repeated turns (action 0) because any orientation-induced image change was rewarded as progress. A generic native source-selected distinction between changed camera heading and observed change with same heading, using regularized action statistics, should break this rotational cycle without programming forward-action preference.

method.feature: Only original raw public before.direction and after.direction, full 7x7 image, source-public carried object slot; no rewards or future outcomes for action choice.
method.learn: For every original selected source before/action/after, count public episode samples, same-heading visual change, orientation change, unchanged, held retention, held loss. No unselected, hidden, or manually labelled movement action.
method.score: For each legal action, score 12*same_heading_image_change/(count+64) - 4*heading_change/(count+64) - 8*held_loss/(count+64) + 4*held_retained_same_heading_image_change/(count+64) when carrying, signed integer scale 1024. Shrink low-support action effects using fixed prior 64. No hardcoded mapping to forward/turn/pickup/drop/toggle action IDs.
method.zero_support: If all action empirical scores are <=0, choose minimum episode-selected action count with deterministic SHA(public, episode selected counts) tie, never a fixed preferred action.
method.episode: Recent raw public before SHA revisits and selected-action counts reset; FIT empirical consequence evidence persists across episodes and cold snapshots. Episode selected counts bounded 192.

limits.context_class: global selected action effect; single held-object bit only for gating held loss/reward

source_tests: Both original unchanged parents still learn selected action exactly once
Selected observed same-heading public image change outranks heading-only visual change despite lower raw overall image novelty
No mapping from particular action code to locomotion
Zero-evidence policy cannot loop on one action forever in identical public state
Wrong/duplicate source feedback rejects without mutation
Checkpoint tamper rejection, native cold restored deterministic next action
Linux and Windows focused R16/DK12 tests, original parent source unchanged

metrics: observed key retained and forward actions
CPU and RSS incl Go child for full resource parity
